## The Challenge

Digital health interventions offer enormous potential to improve health outcomes and extend the reach of healthcare services. Yet their benefits are not equally distributed. 

Factors including **digital skills**, **health literacy**, **self-efficacy**, **socio-digital norms** and **trust** shape whether individuals can meaningfully engage with digital health tools --- and these factors cluster in ways that deepen existing health inequalities.

The Digital Health Enablement (DHE) project is a programme of doctoral research based at the **University of Bath**, developing and validating a new psychometric instrument --- the **Digital Health Enablement Scale (DHES)** --- designed to measure individual-level enablement for digital health engagement.
